body.statement: Can the contraction--Möbius handle establish \(\mathcal N_3=\mathcal F_3\) without enumerating response maps, including a proof that when \(g(U)=\{a,b\}\) the remaining factor \(c\) yields exactly four null maps when unresponsive alone and exactly two null maps when responsive alone?
body.justification: This is the non-enumerative behavioral step that turns a finite search result into an economic choice theorem.
body.gap: Goff's two-factor application uses exhaustive search and does not resolve the first three-factor full-offer-pair branch.
body.consumer: A solution certifies the response class used by Theorems 1--3 and makes the resulting relaxation auditable without code.
